## Change and reason

Describe the behavior change and why it is needed.

## Evidence

List the checks run and the tested revision. Distinguish source/mock checks from
live Azure or local observations. For rebuilt images, describe the inspected
contents rather than only a changed digest. Do not attach credentials or raw logs.

## Documentation and safety

Describe guide updates, changed permissions or ownership rules, and any known
limitations. Explain any omitted checks. Follow the security policy for private
vulnerability reports.
